issue_context.title: can't download historical stats of the time before GC safe point through HTTP API even the historical stats exist
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

1. create a table, insert data, and analyze it several times
2. wait for 10min+
3. start a new tidb to join the cluster
4. on the new tidb, try to use HTTP API (`http://{TiDBIP}:10080/stats/dump/{db}/{table}/{yyyyMMddHHmmss}`) to download the stats with the time right after the first analyze.

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

Successfully download the stats of the first analyze.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```
[tikv:9006]GC life time is shorter than transaction duration, transaction starts at xxx, GC safe point is xxx
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

7.1, master

review_comments: better to clarify this in the doc for the default behavior？

Currently, the historical stats lack docs. This PR aims to make historical stats at least usable as soon as possible since it's already been enabled now.
The behavior changed here is a bit too detailed for the user. I think we can clarify this when we add doc for the historical stats.
